text.en:
The bond of five thousand pesos furnished by Simeon Lopez and Sabas de Guzman in favor of
the defendant Rufino Dizon, alias Dy Quian, alias Juan Dizon, et al., which has been declared forfeited by the
Court of First Instance of Manila, is hereby remitted after the expenses actually incurred by the Government
in the execution of the said bail bond have been deducted.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 3, 1930.
